defs.def: to be unable to remember sth that has happened in the past or information that you knew in the past 通常不用于进行时

ex.s: On a regular day， students at the school sometimes come up to him to say they're not feeling well or other times to tell him about something that happened at break． He knows most of the kids at the school， but can't name each one． Some of them make him know them． Like Faith， who often forgets her backpack in the cafeteria， and Lucy， who just wants a hug．
ex.t: 平常的一天，学校里的学生有时会走到他面前说他们不舒服，有时则会告诉他课间发生的事。他认识学校里大多数孩子，却叫不出每个人的名字。有些孩子让他记住了自己，比如常常把背包忘在食堂的Faith，还有只想拥抱一下的Lucy。

ex.s: Don’t forget to stop by Pacific Science Center’s Store while you are here to pick up a wonderful science activity or remember your visit.
ex.t: 在此期间，别忘了顺道去太平洋科学中心的商店，挑选一项精彩的科学活动或纪念品来纪念你的参观。

defs.def: to not remember to do sth that you ought to do, or to bring or buy sth that you ought to bring or buy 忘记做（或带、买等）

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

ex.s: Climate change has been forgotten.
ex.t: 气候变化已经被遗忘。

ex.s: We tend to forget that sea level is a product of technically and culturally determined assumptions.
ex.t: 我们往往忘记，海平面其实是由技术和文化因素决定的一系列假设的产物。

ex.s: It doesn’t mean you have to ignore what’s happened or forget it.
ex.t: 这并不意味着你必须忽视或忘记已经发生的事。

ex.s: A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news.
ex.t: 几周后，当我几乎忘记这场比赛时，消息传来了。

ex.s: A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news.
ex.t: 几周后，当我几乎忘记这场比赛时，消息传来了。

ex.s: These gentle, lovely gatekeepers welcomed her and kick-started what was to be a trip Ginni would never forget.
ex.t: 这些温柔可爱的守门人欢迎了她，开启了Ginni永远不会忘记的一段旅程。

ex.s: “What people forget is that the Italians, when they came to Australia, brought 2000 years of their culture, the Greeks some 3000 years, and the Chinese more still.
ex.t: ‘人们忘记的是，意大利人来澳大利亚时带来了2000年的文化，希腊人大约3000年，中国人则更久。’

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: It was a moment I'll never forget.”
ex.t: “那是我永生难忘的一刻。”

ex.s: Dismissing small talk as unimportant is easy, but we can’t forget that deep relationships wouldn’t even exist if it weren’t for casual conversation.
ex.t: 把闲聊视为不重要的事情很容易，但我们不能忘记如果没有闲聊，深厚的关系甚至不会存在。

ex.s: It was an extraordinary experience and something I will never forget.
ex.t: 这是一种非凡的经历，我永远不会忘记。

ex.s: Do you ever get to the train station and realize you forgot to bring something to read?
ex.t: 你有没有过到了火车站才发现忘了带读物的时候？

ex.s: He forgets to do his job.
ex.t: 他忘了做他的工作。

ex.s: And don't forget to put out some cookies and fruits.
ex.t: 还有，别忘了拿出一些饼干和水果。

ex.s: If you forget to officially drop that course, a “F” (Fail) grade will be registered on your record at the end of the term.
ex.t: 如果你忘记正式退选那门课程，学期末你的成绩单上将记入一个“F”（不及格）成绩。

ex.s: We bravely drove off again two hours later after we’d returned home to get the purse and traveler’s checks Mom had forgotten.
ex.t: 第2段： 我们穿过几个州，沿途看到了很多美景。

ex.s: I forget to wind up the clock.
ex.t: 我忘了给钟上发条。

ex.s: Don’t forget to check in online and print your boarding pass in advance.
ex.t: 别忘了在线办理登机手续，并提前打印您的登机牌。

defs.def: to deliberately stop thinking about sb/sth 不再想；不再把 … 放在心上
to stop thinking that sth is a possibility 不再考虑 … 的可能
to behave in a way that is not socially acceptable （举止）不得体

ex.s: So, don’t forget to pick up some chicken on your way home and try this recipe out!
ex.t: 所以，别忘了在回家的路上买些鸡肉，试试这个食谱！

ex.s: Forget itD.
ex.t: 算了吧。

defs.def: （表示不想重复说过的话）别提它了

ex.s: I forgot what he had said to me altogether.
ex.t: 我把他对我说的话全忘了。

defs.def: 住嘴；别再烦人地说下去了
